object.attr: stakeholder: no exponent, infinity or NaN, which a filter can't compare and each language parses differently. Decided on 2026-11-10; MELLON-CHECK-SRS checks the same form (review Q21).
object.description: An object file shall hold a real value as an optional minus sign, one or more of the digits 0 to 9, and optionally a point followed by digits, nothing else.
